name: SetCredentials
label: Save Credential Manager Credentials
description: Saves credentials to Windows Credential Manager for a specified target.

fields.name: TargetName
fields.label: Target Name
fields.description: The name of the credential target used to store in Credential Manager.

fields.name: AccountName
fields.label: Account Name
fields.description: The username to be saved in the Credential Manager.

fields.name: Password
fields.label: Password
fields.description: The password associated with the account to be stored securely.
